.. itacart documentation master file.

============================================
Welcome to ITACaRT's Documentation!
============================================

**ITACaRT** (ITA Cadastral Ellipsoidal Reference Tessellation) is an innovative Discrete Global Grid System (DGGS) developed at the Aeronautics Institute of Technology (ITA). It is specifically designed to address the unique requirements of terrestrial cadastral mapping and to provide a robust spatial infrastructure for modern Land Administration Systems (LAS).

Developed in accordance with the foundational principles of the OGC Abstract Specification Topic 21, ITACaRT provides a new way to organize and analyze spatio-temporal data. The system introduces a novel approach using equal-area parallelogram cells tessellated directly on the WGS84 ellipsoid to ensure geodetic precision for cadastral applications.

A key feature is its **Compositional Hierarchical Indexing** system, engineered to represent vector features efficiently and to provide a stable spatial framework for emerging technologies like blockchain.

This documentation provides a comprehensive guide to installing, using, and contributing to the `itacart` Python package.
